newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eridania confirms stable profit forecast.
newsitem.headline: Eridania confirms stable profit forecast.

text.p: Eridania Beghin-Say chairman Stefano Meloni on Thursday reaffirmed a forecast of stable net profit for 1996.
"Despite a difficult environment in four or five of our businesses, Eridania Beghin-Say could report a net profit around the level of 1995," Meloni told a news conference.
Meloni said the performance of starch unit Cerestar should improve in the second half as it had already started to pass on to customers rises farm raw materials prices.
The sugar sector in Italy is also expected to improve in the second half, he said.
But the starch and oilseeds crushings business in North America is not expected to recover much in the second half.

Eridania earlier reported a net attributable profit of 745 million francs for the first half of 1996, versus 825 billion francs in the first half of 1995. 1995 net attributable profit was 1,526 million francs.
